decks.notes: This Rakdos Aggro deck focuses on aggressive creature plays and disruption. It utilizes cards like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to pressure the opponent while also using cards like Grief and Thoughtseize to disrupt their plans. The inclusion of cards like Blood Moon and Magus of the Moon can also punish non-basic land heavy decks. With a mix of removal spells like Terminate and Lightning Bolt, this deck aims to quickly overwhelm the opponent and close out the game before they can establish their own game plan.

The deck focuses on utilizing cards like Amulet of Vigor and Primeval Titan to assemble powerful land combinations quickly while also utilizing cards like Dryad of the Ilysian Grove to ramp up mana production. The goal is to use these land combinations and ramping abilities to generate a huge advantage on the battlefield, allowing the player to overwhelm their opponent with large creatures and game-winning combos. Through efficient mana ramping and land manipulation, the deck can create explosive plays and secure victory in a fast-paced and proactive manner.

This deck focuses on aggressive plays and disrupting the opponent's strategy with cards like Grief and Thoughtseize. It also utilizes powerful, low-cost creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Seasoned Pyromancer to quickly overwhelm the opponent. Feign Death and Undying Malice are used to protect key creatures and maintain pressure on the opponent. Blood Moon is included to disrupt the opponent's mana base, while cards like Terminate and Lightning Bolt provide removal options. Overall, this deck aims to apply early pressure and maintain control throughout the game.

This deck focuses on utilizing powerful creatures with varying colors and abilities to quickly overwhelm the opponent and deal damage efficiently. By including Jegantha as a companion, the deck gains access to additional mana and a potential late-game advantage. With a mix of aggressive creatures like Nishoba Brawler and Territorial Kavu, along with versatile spells like Tribal Flames and Stubborn Denial, this deck aims to maintain board presence and pressure the opponent consistently. The mana base is carefully designed to support the diverse color requirements of the deck.

The main concept of this deck is to utilize the combination of Fable of the Mirror-Breaker, Archon of Cruelty, and Indomitable Creativity to create powerful and unexpected board states. The deck focuses on using creativity and innovation to disrupt the opponent's game plan and secure victory through unique combo interactions. The inclusion of various spells and lands like Prismari Command, Lightning Bolt, and Wrenn and Six provide additional support and flexibility to the combo strategy. This deck aims to surprise and outsmart opponents by thinking outside the box and embracing unconventional strategies.

The deck focuses on assembling a fast and powerful equipment combo using creatures like Stoneforge Mystic, Puresteel Paladin, and Colossus Hammer. By equipping Colossus Hammer onto a creature and using Puresteel Paladin's ability to draw cards, the deck can deal lethal damage in a single swing. The deck also includes efficient protection and mana ramp cards to support the combo. Urza's Saga is used to tutor for key pieces, making the deck consistent and deadly in the early game. The goal is to quickly overwhelm the opponent with a huge, unstoppable attacker.

This UR Aggro deck focuses on quickly establishing board presence and applying pressure on the opponent through efficient creatures and burn spells. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells and removal while also utilizing card selection and card advantage to maintain a strong tempo. The deck's mana base includes fetchlands and shocklands for consistency and flexibility. By consistently threatening the opponent with early aggression and disruption, the deck seeks to close out games quickly before the opponent can stabilize.

The main focus of this UR Aggro deck is to put pressure on the opponent quickly using efficient and versatile threats like Murktide Regent, Dragon's Rage Channeler, and Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer. The deck also aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with counterspells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce, while also generating card advantage through cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration. The mana base is designed to support the deck's aggressive game plan, with access to both red and blue mana sources to cast a variety of spells efficiently.

This combo deck utilizes Indomitable Creativity to cheat out powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty by sacrificing tokens from Dwarven Mine. Fable of the Mirror-Breaker helps to set up the combo, while Wrenn and Six provide recursion for lands and other spells. The deck includes counter spells like Spell Pierce and removal like Lightning Bolt to protect the combo pieces. The deck also includes tools like Prismari Command and Unholy Heat for additional versatility and card advantage. The overall strategy is to be creative in utilizing different cards to assemble the combo and outvalue opponents.

The deck focuses on assembling a variety of creatures to tutor for using Chord of Calling and Eldritch Evolution, utilizing them as a toolbox to create a powerful combo engine. Key cards such as Yawgmoth, Thran Physician and Grist, the Hunger Tide interact with creatures like Hapatra, Vizier of Poisons and Blood Artist to generate value and drain the opponent's life total. The mana base includes lands like Urborg, Tomb of Yawgmoth and Twilight Mire to support the deck's multicolor requirements and ensure consistency in executing its game plan.

The deck focuses on efficiently reducing the opponent's life total while utilizing Death's Shadow as a powerful threat. By combining aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Dragon's Rage Channeler with disruptive spells like Thoughtseize and Unholy Heat, it aims to apply early pressure and disrupt the opponent's game plan. The inclusion of cards like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration help filter cards and maintain card advantage. The deck's mana base consists of fetch lands and shock lands to ensure consistency and flexibility in casting spells.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly assemble the combo of Colossus Hammer and Puresteel Paladin to deal massive damage to the opponent in a short amount of time. The deck includes a lot of low cost artifact creatures and equipment to enable this combo to be set up quickly and efficiently. The Urza's Saga enchantment also helps to tutor for key pieces of the combo, while providing additional value with its ability to create tokens. This deck aims to be aggressive and threatening, overwhelming the opponent with its powerful combo potential.

This Hammer Time deck focuses on quickly assembling powerful equipment onto creatures like Puresteel Paladin and Stoneforge Mystic, allowing for explosive combos and massive damage potential. The key strategy involves using cheap equipment like Colossus Hammer in combination with cards like Sigarda's Aid and Giver of Runes to protect and enhance your creatures. Urza's Saga provides additional value by tutoring for key artifacts, while cards like Spell Pierce offer disruption against opponents. By efficiently equipping your creatures with powerful artifacts, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents and secure a quick victory.

The main concept of this deck is to assemble a powerful combo using equipment like Colossus Hammer and Sigarda's Aid to quickly equip creatures like Gingerbrute and Kaldra Compleat, allowing for fast and lethal attacks. The deck also includes efficient creatures like Stoneforge Mystic and Puresteel Paladin to help search for and equip the necessary pieces. The inclusion of Urza's Saga further enhances the deck's ability to search for key artifacts. With strong early-game plays and a focus on fast, aggressive strategies, this deck aims to overwhelm opponents with swift and deadly combos.

The main concept of this Merfolk deck is to overwhelm the opponent quickly with a swarm of Merfolk creatures, supported by lords like Lord of Atlantis and Master of the Pearl Trident to boost their power and toughness. Using cards like Merfolk Trickster and Tide Shaper, the deck aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan while maintaining pressure. With additional support from Svyelun of Sea and Sky and Vodalian Hexcatcher, along with control elements like Subtlety and Force of Negation, this deck seeks to outpace and outmaneuver the opponent in a fast-paced aggressive strategy.

The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to maintain control of the game by utilizing a combination of aggressive creatures like Ragavan, Nimble Pilferer and Murktide Regent, while also disrupting the opponent's game plan with a suite of counter spells like Counterspell and Spell Pierce. The deck aims to apply pressure early on by playing efficient threats and removing opposing threats with cards like Lightning Bolt and Unholy Heat. The deck also includes card selection and advantage engines like Mishra's Bauble and Expressive Iteration to ensure a consistent stream of threats and answers.
